title: InvisLight
description: Adds craftable light block using torch and any 8 glasses
body:
# Functions

It is simple datapack that adds craft for light block in Minecraft.

## Why

I always wanted to craft light block by using any kind of glass and I have achieved my goal. (Mojang added really cool mechanic in 26.1). This datapack will provide recipe when players joins world first time. Then player will be able to craft 8 light blocks using torch in the middle and 8 any combinations of glass blocks (For example 4 orange glass and 4 ordinary glass blocks). Tinted glass can not be used for logical reasons (they do not transmit light).
